mapper.select: SELECT num_val FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE oprt_std_id='PLAN_GAP_TOLERANCE' AND aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1

WITH plans AS ( SELECT prj_id,job_cd,SUM(need_mm_qty) AS mm FROM prj.psn_plan WHERE plan_ym BETWEEN CONCAT(#{year},'-01') AND CONCAT(#{year},'-12') GROUP BY prj_id,job_cd ), actuals AS ( SELECT a.prj_id,a.job_cd,SUM(m.mm_qty) AS mm FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id WHERE a.asgn_stts_cd != 'CANCELLED' AND m.work_ym BETWEEN CONCAT(#{year},'-01') AND CONCAT(#{year},'-12') GROUP BY a.prj_id,a.job_cd ), combined AS ( SELECT COALESCE(p.prj_id,a.prj_id) AS prj_id,COALESCE(p.job_cd,a.job_cd) AS job_cd, COALESCE(p.mm,0) AS plan_mm, COALESCE(a.mm,0) AS actual_mm FROM plans p FULL OUTER JOIN actuals a ON a.prj_id=p.prj_id AND a.job_cd=p.job_cd ) SELECT p.prj_id AS project_id,p.prj_nm AS project_name,c.job_cd AS job, COALESCE(d.cd_nm,c.job_cd) AS job_name,c.plan_mm,c.actual_mm FROM combined c JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=c.prj_id LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl d ON d.cd_grp_id='JOB' AND d.dtl_cd=c.job_cd WHERE p.use_yn='Y' AND p.prj_stts_cd != 'LOST' AND p.prfm_bgn_dt <= make_date(#{year},12,31) AND p.cur_end_dt >= make_date(#{year},1,1) AND (c.plan_mm != 0 OR c.actual_mm != 0) AND p.prj_id=#{projectId} AND c.job_cd=#{job}
